post.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash — Six AI Builds
post.excerpt: Six Gemini 3.8 Flash prompts, from 3D games and city scenes to an SVG studio and restaurant website. Preview every build and download its complete source.
post.content: Episode 02 brings together all six builds from the Gemini 3.8 Flash video. The prompts and projects follow the original video order: a fantasy platformer, an open-world city game, a procedural city showcase, a hypercar studio, an SVG programmer room, and a premium restaurant website. Each prompt includes its matching live preview and source download.

prompts.title: ORIGINAL 3D PLATFORMER GAME
prompts.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash · Prompt 01 — A colorful fantasy platformer with floating islands, collectibles, enemies, and checkpoints.
prompts.content:
Create a complete 3D platformer browser game inspired by classic side-scrolling platform games.

Do not copy Super Mario characters, assets, or levels. Create an original fantasy world.

Requirements:

- Create a colorful 3D cartoon environment.
- Create a player character that can run, jump, and interact with the world.
- Add platforms with different heights.
- Add moving platforms.
- Add collectible coins.
- Add power-up items that temporarily improve the player.
- Add enemies with simple AI.
- Add obstacles and traps.
- Add checkpoints.
- Add a health/life system.
- Add a final goal flag at the end of the level.
- Add smooth animations.
- Add camera following the player.
- Add background music placeholders and sound effects.

The game should feel polished, fun, and immediately playable.

IMPORTANT:
- Do not ask me any questions.
- Make all creative decisions yourself.
- Start coding immediately.
- Use only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
- Do not use React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, or any framework.
- The project must run by opening index.html directly.
- Use CDN libraries only if needed.
- Create complete working code, not just explanations.

prompts.title: MINI GTA STYLE OPEN WORLD
prompts.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash · Prompt 02 — Explore a living city with vehicles, traffic, missions, weather, and a wanted system.
prompts.content:
Create a small 3D open-world city game inspired by open-world driving games.

Do not copy GTA characters, branding, or assets.

Requirements:

- Create a detailed 3D city environment.
- Add roads, buildings, sidewalks, traffic lights, parks, and signs.
- Add a player character who can walk around.
- Add vehicles that the player can enter and drive.
- Add basic car physics.
- Add pedestrians walking around the city.
- Add simple traffic AI.
- Add a minimap.
- Add day and night cycle.
- Add weather changes.
- Add police AI that follows the player after crimes.
- Add wanted level system.
- Add missions such as reaching locations or delivering objects.

Focus on creating a living city that looks impressive in a video demonstration.

- Make all creative decisions yourself.
- Start coding immediately.
- Use only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
- Do not use React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, or any framework.

Requirements:

- Add skyscrapers with different designs.
- Add streets, sidewalks, intersections, traffic lights, signs, and advertisements.
- Add trees, parks, benches, street lamps, and small details.
- Add moving cars.
- Add walking pedestrians.
- Add reflections on windows.
- Add realistic lighting.
- Add sunrise, sunset, and night modes.
- Add realistic camera movement.
- Add cinematic camera shots.
- Add weather effects such as rain or fog.

prompts.title: DETAILED SVG PROGRAMMER ROOM
prompts.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash · Prompt 05 — An editable vector illustration of a programmer's room with lighting controls and SVG export.
prompts.content:
Create a detailed SVG illustration of a programmer working inside a modern computer room.

The scene must show:

* A person sitting naturally on an office chair.
* The person is sitting directly in front of a computer desk.
* A desktop computer monitor is placed on the desk.
* The person is actively programming, with their hands positioned on a keyboard.
* Show a visible coding interface on the monitor using colorful code-like text and UI elements.
* Add a computer mouse, keyboard, desk accessories, and cables.
* Add a desk lamp.
* Add shelves or wall decorations in the background.
* Add a window with a night-time city view.
* Add subtle ambient lighting from the computer monitor.
* Add a small plant and a few realistic room details.
* Use a coherent perspective and professional composition.
* Include detailed character proportions, clothing, hair, facial features, hands, chair, desk, monitor, and room objects.
* Use gradients, shadows, highlights, layered shapes, and carefully constructed paths to make the SVG visually rich.
* Use a modern professional illustration style rather than a very simple icon style.
* Make the final SVG large, detailed, clean, and visually impressive.

Technical requirements:

* The main artwork must be created as SVG.
* Keep the SVG editable and vector-based.
* Do not simply embed a raster image as the final artwork.
* Organize the SVG into logical groups/layers such as background, room, desk, computer, person, lighting, and decorative objects.
* Add subtle SVG animations where they improve the scene, such as monitor glow, blinking cursor, or small ambient lighting effects.
* Display the final SVG prominently in the browser.
* Add a button that allows the user to download/export the generated SVG.

The final result should look like a polished professional vector illustration of a programmer working late at night.


IMPORTANT:
- Do not ask me any questions.
- Make all creative decisions yourself.
- Start coding immediately.
- Use only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
- Do not use React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, or any framework.
- The project must run by opening index.html directly.
- Use CDN libraries only if needed.
- Create complete working code, not just explanations.
